news.title: Valar、Atreides与Sequoia领投AI初创公司Flow Engineering，估值达7.5亿美元
news.snippet: 成立三年的AI初创公司Flow Engineering获多家知名风投加持，估值达7.5亿美元。
news.raw_snippet: Flow Engineering, a three-year-old artificial intelligence startup based in San Francisco, has secured $50 million in Series B funding at a post-money valuation of $750 million. The financing marks a significant milestone for the hardware design automation firm and underscores growing institutional confidence in AI-driven engineering workflows. [...] The round was co-led by Antonio Gracias of Valar Equity Partners and Gavin Baker of Atreides Management. Valar and Atreides maintain established track records backing high-growth ventures, including multiple entities associated with Elon Musk and specialized semiconductor developers like Cerebras. Sequoia Capital, which previously led the company’s Series A round last October, participated in the latest transaction. Former Sequoia partner Roelof Botha also contributed as an individual investor [...] individual investor and will assume a seat on Flow Engineering’s board of directors.

news.title: ElevenLabs估值翻倍至220亿美元，AI语音Agent需求激增
news.snippet: AI语音初创公司ElevenLabs获融资，估值升至220亿美元，反映企业语音Agent需求强劲。
news.raw_snippet:
Sept 30 (Reuters) - ElevenLabs said on Wednesday it had completed a $300 million employee tender offer valuing the AI voice generation startup at $22 ​billion, twice the valuation it secured in its February ‌funding round.

The tender was led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price, with participation from existing backers such as Andreessen Horowitz and Lightspeed, and new ​investors including EQT and Goldman Sachs. [...] "We're already seeing rapid adoption of expressive voice agents by ​enterprises and governments, who are deploying them in ​service of ⁠consumers and citizens," co-founder and CEO Mati Staniszewski said.

Its models can speak, listen and translate in more than 90 languages used by ⁠over ​5.5 billion people, according to the ​company.

The company was valued at $11 billion after raising $500 million in a Series D funding round ​in February. [...] Jumpstart your morning with the latest legal news delivered straight to your inbox from The Daily Docket newsletter. Sign up here.

Unlike a conventional fundraising ​round, a tender offer allows employees and existing shareholders ⁠to sell their stocks to investors, providing liquidity without necessarily ​raising new capital.

news.title: Verizon CEO预测18个月内实现AGI，十年将迎百年科技进步
news.snippet: Dan Schulman认为通用人工智能AGI将在18个月内出现，未来十年科技进步堪比一个世纪。
news.raw_snippet:
Chris Nelson, CEO of Stanley Black & Decker, described a similar transition on job sites. His company has developed AI-enabled autonomous drilling robots that can use digital construction plans to drill holes for racks in data centers and other projects.

The technology is designed to take over repetitive physical tasks—not replace the electricians and skilled tradespeople needed to complete the higher-value work. [...] AGI, or artificial general intelligence, is a term generally used for systems that can reason and perform broadly across domains rather than excel at discrete tasks. Schulman argued that AI’s economic and social effects will arrive at a pace that outstrips the usual mechanisms for absorbing technological change, such as training systems, labor markets, corporate restructuring and public policy. “It is about machines that will in many ways be able to do things better than a lot of human tasks [...] “Go take your favorite AI tool” and look up articles from 40 years ago about personal computers, Regnery said. “They’re identical.”

His company sees AI as a way to make buildings run more efficiently, rather than simply to reduce headcount. Trane is using data and AI to manage heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems according to how buildings are actually used, he said—not merely according to their original design specifications.
